notes.title: Demo available now
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620787/bf2636a84200f8f41f629699f5b0d64e1ceea1b8.gif"]


Over 20 fish species, new desktop figures, aquarium decorations, and more are now available in the demo. After checking out your fish, feel free to share with us what you’d like to see more of in the game through the feedback report in the settings panel
